paragraphs.source_en: In the fifteenth year of Keichō, peace prevailed throughout the realm.

units.source_en: In the fifteenth year of Keichō, peace prevailed throughout the realm.
units.source_zh: 庆长十五年，天下平安无事。

paragraphs.source_zh: 庆长十五年，天下平安无事。

paragraphs.source_en: Toyotomi Hideyori and his mother devoted their energies to rebuilding the Great Buddha Hall of Hōkō-ji in Kyoto, while Ieyasu, though unable to go to the capital, busied himself with Nagoya Castle. Meanwhile, the number of vessels engaged in overseas trade continued to grow, and time slipped quietly by amid Ieyasu's confidence and contentment.

units.source_en: Toyotomi Hideyori and his mother devoted their energies to rebuilding the Great Buddha Hall of Hōkō-ji in Kyoto, while Ieyasu, though unable to go to the capital, busied himself with Nagoya Castle.

ja.t: こそできなかったものの、

units.source_zh: 丰臣秀赖母子把精力放在重建京都方广寺的大佛殿上，家康虽未能进京，却也在为名古屋城忙碌。

units.source_en: Meanwhile, the number of vessels engaged in overseas trade continued to grow, and time slipped quietly by amid Ieyasu's confidence and contentment.
units.source_zh: 同时，海外交易船只数量不断增加，时光在家康的自信和满足中悄然而逝。

paragraphs.source_zh: 丰臣秀赖母子把精力放在重建京都方广寺的大佛殿上，家康虽未能进京，却也在为名古屋城忙碌。同时，海外交易船只数量不断增加，时光在家康的自信和满足中悄然而逝。

paragraphs.source_en: In an age of peace, the nation had to turn its eyes overseas. Venturing overseas brought not only profits from trade but other benefits as well, foremost among them the power to transform people's outlook. The disorder of the warring age, when warriors gloried in violence and plundered with impunity, began to give way, and people turned to cultivating themselves and ordering their households. Broadening the people's horizons was the greatest benefit of looking overseas.

units.source_en: In an age of peace, the nation had to turn its eyes overseas.
units.source_zh: 太平时代，国家须走向海外。

units.source_en: Venturing overseas brought not only profits from trade but other benefits as well, foremost among them the power to transform people's outlook.

ja.t: ばかりでなく、ほかにも

units.source_zh: 走向海外，不仅能通过交易获利，也有其他益处，首先便是可借此转变世人观念。

units.source_en: The disorder of the warring age, when warriors gloried in violence and plundered with impunity, began to give way, and people turned to cultivating themselves and ordering their households.
units.source_zh: 乱世中武士好勇斗狠、横暴掠夺的混乱情形得以改变，世人开始修身齐家。

units.source_en: Broadening the people's horizons was the greatest benefit of looking overseas.
units.source_zh: 苍生眼界大开，乃是走向海外最大的效用。

paragraphs.source_zh: 太平时代，国家须走向海外。走向海外，不仅能通过交易获利，也有其他益处，首先便是可借此转变世人观念。乱世中武士好勇斗狠、横暴掠夺的混乱情形得以改变，世人开始修身齐家。苍生眼界大开，乃是走向海外最大的效用。

paragraphs.source_en: Second, the nine red-seal ships first commissioned in the Bunroku era had now increased to one hundred and fifty, while ever more ambitious rōnin were sailing abroad. Some still retained their violent nature and often drew condemnation wherever they went; nevertheless, overseas enterprise at least showed a vast host of quarrelsome men a way to live, and that was no small benefit.

units.source_en: Second, the nine red-seal ships first commissioned in the Bunroku era had now increased to one hundred and fifty, while ever more ambitious rōnin were sailing abroad.
units.source_zh: 其次，文禄年间始设朱印船九艘，至今已增至一百五十艘，航行海外的雄心勃勃的浪人，也益发增多。

units.source_en: Some still retained their violent nature and often drew condemnation wherever they went; nevertheless, overseas enterprise at least showed a vast host of quarrelsome men a way to live, and that was no small benefit.

ja.t: したというだけで、その

units.source_zh: 其中虽有身上仍残留粗暴根性之人，所至之处时常招来非难，然而至少给一大群好勇斗狠之人暗示了一条活路，利益不可谓不大。

paragraphs.source_zh: 其次，文禄年间始设朱印船九艘，至今已增至一百五十艘，航行海外的雄心勃勃的浪人，也益发增多。其中虽有身上仍残留粗暴根性之人，所至之处时常招来非难，然而至少给一大群好勇斗狠之人暗示了一条活路，利益不可谓不大。

paragraphs.source_en: Third, trade brought foreign cultures into the country and thereby influenced the minds of its people. In every age, wisdom and wealth can stir a breeze of concord, and that breeze in turn gives rise to new hopes and dreams.

units.source_en: Third, trade brought foreign cultures into the country and thereby influenced the minds of its people.
units.source_zh: 其三，交易往来带来海外文化，从而影响国人心智。

units.source_en: In every age, wisdom and wealth can stir a breeze of concord, and that breeze in turn gives rise to new hopes and dreams.
units.source_zh: 智慧和财富在任何时代都能吹起和合之风，此风又将让人生出新的希望和梦想。

paragraphs.source_zh: 其三，交易往来带来海外文化，从而影响国人心智。智慧和财富在任何时代都能吹起和合之风，此风又将让人生出新的希望和梦想。

paragraphs.source_en: Nagoya Castle displayed its majesty along the Tōkaidō, while the great daimyō vied with one another to settle their wives and children in Edo.

units.source_en: Nagoya Castle displayed its majesty along the Tōkaidō, while the great daimyō vied with one another to settle their wives and children in Edo.
units.source_zh: 名古屋城在东海道显示威容，各大名则争相把妻儿安置到江户。

paragraphs.source_zh: 名古屋城在东海道显示威容，各大名则争相把妻儿安置到江户。

paragraphs.source_en: During the construction of Nagoya, Katō Kiyomasa's zeal attracted the greatest attention. Kiyomasa showed not the slightest hint of merely going through the motions in discharging his obligations. He volunteered to level the hills below the castle and opened up a vast tract of land around it. Faced with the formidable problem of transporting enormous stones, he devised an ingenious solution and became the talk of the realm.

units.source_en: During the construction of Nagoya, Katō Kiyomasa's zeal attracted the greatest attention.
units.source_zh: 筑建名古屋时，加藤清正的热心最是引人注目。

units.source_en: Kiyomasa showed not the slightest hint of merely going through the motions in discharging his obligations.

ja.t: して、いささかもおざなりな

units.source_zh: 对于应尽之义务，清正未流露出丝毫应付之态。

units.source_en: He volunteered to level the hills below the castle and opened up a vast tract of land around it.
units.source_zh: 他主动负责铲平城下的丘陵，开拓出城周的大片土地。

units.source_en: Faced with the formidable problem of transporting enormous stones, he devised an ingenious solution and became the talk of the realm.
units.source_zh: 面对搬运巨石的大难题，他巧用良方，一时名动天下。

paragraphs.source_zh: 筑建名古屋时，加藤清正的热心最是引人注目。对于应尽之义务，清正未流露出丝毫应付之态。他主动负责铲平城下的丘陵，开拓出城周的大片土地。面对搬运巨石的大难题，他巧用良方，一时名动天下。

paragraphs.source_en: Kiyomasa appointed Hara Saburōzaemon and Hayashi Mataichirō, both former grooms to the Taikō, to select more than a hundred tayū from Rokujō Misujimachi; with those who joined later, the courtesans numbered over four hundred, making Nagoya resemble a garden in riotous bloom.

units.source_en: Kiyomasa appointed Hara Saburōzaemon and Hayashi Mataichirō, both former grooms to the Taikō, to select more than a hundred tayū from Rokujō Misujimachi; with those who joined later, the courtesans numbered over four hundred, making Nagoya resemble a garden in riotous bloom.
units.source_zh: 清正任命先前曾给太阁做过马夫的原三郎左卫门、林又一郎二人，从六条三筋町挑选一百多名太夫过来，再加上后来临时加入的，妓女总数超过四百，一时使名古屋如同百花齐放的园林。

paragraphs.source_zh: 清正任命先前曾给太阁做过马夫的原三郎左卫门、林又一郎二人，从六条三筋町挑选一百多名太夫过来，再加上后来临时加入的，妓女总数超过四百，一时使名古屋如同百花齐放的园林。

paragraphs.source_en: The tayū of that time were not merely courtesans in wine shops and teahouses; they also included the leading performers of women's kabuki.

units.source_en: The tayū of that time were not merely courtesans in wine shops and teahouses; they also included the leading performers of women's kabuki.
units.source_zh: 此时的太夫，不只是酒坊茶肆里的妓女，还有女歌舞伎中的头牌。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时的太夫，不只是酒坊茶肆里的妓女，还有女歌舞伎中的头牌。

paragraphs.source_en: After Izumo no Okuni began performing kabuki in the eighth year of Keichō, the dance gradually made its way into the pleasure quarters. Breaking with old custom, the women erected booths along the banks of the Shijō River, performed voluptuous dances by day, and received customers by night. When the courtesans went to Nagoya, a remarkably large number of people followed in their wake.

units.source_en: After Izumo no Okuni began performing kabuki in the eighth year of Keichō, the dance gradually made its way into the pleasure quarters.
units.source_zh: 自从庆长八年出云的阿国跳起歌舞伎之后，这种舞蹈逐渐传入青楼。

units.source_en: Breaking with old custom, the women erected booths along the banks of the Shijō River, performed voluptuous dances by day, and received customers by night.
units.source_zh: 她们一改旧习，在四条河岸搭起小屋，白天跳冶艳的舞蹈，晚上接客。

units.source_en: When the courtesans went to Nagoya, a remarkably large number of people followed in their wake.
units.source_zh: 妓女们到了名古屋，追随她们而来的人，数目亦甚是可观。

paragraphs.source_zh: 自从庆长八年出云的阿国跳起歌舞伎之后，这种舞蹈逐渐传入青楼。她们一改旧习，在四条河岸搭起小屋，白天跳冶艳的舞蹈，晚上接客。妓女们到了名古屋，追随她们而来的人，数目亦甚是可观。

paragraphs.source_en: Dressed in the male costumes worn for tekodance, they hauled the stones piled at Atsuta. At their head was the renowned “Demon Magistrate,” Katō Kiyomasa. There he stood atop a stone, a white cloth wrapped around his head and a brocade robe of scarlet ground upon his body, calling the cadence as his proud whiskers streamed in the wind. Never before had there been such a spectacle.

units.source_en: Dressed in the male costumes worn for tekodance, they hauled the stones piled at Atsuta.
units.source_zh: 她们穿着跳手古舞的男装行头，拉运堆放在热田的石头。

units.source_en: At their head was the renowned “Demon Magistrate,” Katō Kiyomasa.
units.source_zh: 领头的便是名震天下的“鬼判官”加藤清正。

units.source_en: There he stood atop a stone, a white cloth wrapped around his head and a brocade robe of scarlet ground upon his body, calling the cadence as his proud whiskers streamed in the wind.
units.source_zh: 但见他头裹素巾，身着赤底锦袍，站在石头上喊着号子，高傲的胡须随风飘动。

units.source_en: Never before had there been such a spectacle.
units.source_zh: 盛况真是前所未有。

paragraphs.source_zh: 她们穿着跳手古舞的男装行头，拉运堆放在热田的石头。领头的便是名震天下的“鬼判官”加藤清正。但见他头裹素巾，身着赤底锦袍，站在石头上喊着号子，高傲的胡须随风飘动。盛况真是前所未有。

paragraphs.source_en: “This will surely set the whole realm astir.”

units.source_en: “This will surely set the whole realm astir.”
units.source_zh: “如此一来，必天下震动。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “如此一来，必天下震动。”

paragraphs.source_en: “All that talk of discord between Edo and Osaka is a lie! Why, even Katō Kiyomasa is working with such devotion!”

units.source_en: “All that talk of discord between Edo and Osaka is a lie!
units.source_zh: “说什么江户大坂不和，都是骗人！

units.source_en: Why, even Katō Kiyomasa is working with such devotion!”
units.source_zh: 连加藤清正都此般热心！”

paragraphs.source_zh: “说什么江户大坂不和，都是骗人！连加藤清正都此般热心！”

paragraphs.source_en: The outside daimyō gathered in Nagoya were profoundly shaken by the spectacle.

units.source_en: The outside daimyō gathered in Nagoya were profoundly shaken by the spectacle.
units.source_zh: 聚集在名古屋的诸外样大名，因此事而震动莫名。

paragraphs.source_zh: 聚集在名古屋的诸外样大名，因此事而震动莫名。

paragraphs.source_en: The golden shachi cast atop the castle keep built by Kiyomasa proclaimed “peace,” lending the structure still greater significance.

units.source_en: The golden shachi cast atop the castle keep built by Kiyomasa proclaimed “peace,” lending the structure still greater significance.

ja.t: すものとして、ひときわ

units.source_zh: 清正建造的天守阁上，铸了黄金虎鲸，昭示“太平”，意义尤为重大。

paragraphs.source_zh: 清正建造的天守阁上，铸了黄金虎鲸，昭示“太平”，意义尤为重大。

paragraphs.source_en: Had Katō Kiyomasa truly calculated all this?

units.source_en: Had Katō Kiyomasa truly calculated all this?
units.source_zh: 加藤清正果真这般算计吗？

paragraphs.source_zh: 加藤清正果真这般算计吗？

paragraphs.source_en: Yet in the end all such criticism vanished without a trace; Japan remained steeped in peace, and the people lived and worked in contentment.

units.source_en: Yet in the end all such criticism vanished without a trace; Japan remained steeped in peace, and the people lived and worked in contentment.
units.source_zh: 然而，这些批评之声最后皆消失无踪，日本国仍一片太平气象，百姓安居乐业。

paragraphs.source_zh: 然而，这些批评之声最后皆消失无踪，日本国仍一片太平气象，百姓安居乐业。

paragraphs.source_en: There were some, however, who remained unmoved. Among them was Ōkubo Nagayasu, who had once collapsed from a stroke but risen again as though deathless and resumed his search for the gold mines of the realm. He merely laughed and said, “Too small, far too small!”

units.source_en: There were some, however, who remained unmoved. Among them was Ōkubo Nagayasu, who had once collapsed from a stroke but risen again as though deathless and resumed his search for the gold mines of the realm.
units.source_zh: 然而也有人对此无动于衷，其中就有那曾经中风倒地、却以不死之身再度站起、重新挖掘天下金山的大久保长安。

units.source_en: He merely laughed and said, “Too small, far too small!”
units.source_zh: 他对此只是笑道：“太小太小！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 然而也有人对此无动于衷，其中就有那曾经中风倒地、却以不死之身再度站起、重新挖掘天下金山的大久保长安。他对此只是笑道：“太小太小！”

paragraphs.source_en: General Vizcaíno had ostensibly come to thank Ieyasu for sending the former governor of Luzon, Don Rodrigo, and his party of more than three hundred and fifty people back to Mexico; in truth, he merely used that as a pretext to explore the Isle of Gold described by Marco Polo.

units.source_en: General Vizcaíno had ostensibly come to thank Ieyasu for sending the former governor of Luzon, Don Rodrigo, and his party of more than three hundred and fifty people back to Mexico; in truth, he merely used that as a pretext to explore the Isle of Gold described by Marco Polo.

ja.t: ドン・ロドリゴとその

units.source_zh: 比斯卡伊诺将军表面上乃是为了答谢家康把前吕宋总督唐·罗德里格及其一行三百五十余人送回墨国而来，其实只是打着这个名头，到马可·波罗描述过的黄金岛来探险。

paragraphs.source_zh: 比斯卡伊诺将军表面上乃是为了答谢家康把前吕宋总督唐·罗德里格及其一行三百五十余人送回墨国而来，其实只是打着这个名头，到马可·波罗描述过的黄金岛来探险。

paragraphs.source_en: In short, the fifteenth year of Keichō was a year brimming with vitality, and the breeze of peace reached every corner of the land. There was only one exception, in a place somewhat removed from the lives of the common people: the imperial palace.

units.source_en: In short, the fifteenth year of Keichō was a year brimming with vitality, and the breeze of peace reached every corner of the land.
units.source_zh: 总之，庆长十五年，乃是充满勃勃生机之年，太平之风吹拂到了每一个角落。

units.source_en: There was only one exception, in a place somewhat removed from the lives of the common people: the imperial palace.
units.source_zh: 然而，此中只有一个例外，发生在与百姓生活稍有些距离的地方，那便是禁宫。

paragraphs.source_zh: 总之，庆长十五年，乃是充满勃勃生机之年，太平之风吹拂到了每一个角落。然而，此中只有一个例外，发生在与百姓生活稍有些距离的地方，那便是禁宫。

paragraphs.source_en: All this had ultimately led, in the twelfth year of Keichō, to numerous scandals between young courtiers and ladies-in-waiting. Desire between men and women is natural, but once natural feeling becomes licentiousness, society can no longer tolerate it. The disorder in the inner court enraged Emperor Go-Yōzei, who immediately ordered Ieyasu to deal with it.

units.source_en: All this had ultimately led, in the twelfth year of Keichō, to numerous scandals between young courtiers and ladies-in-waiting.
units.source_zh: 如此种种，最终演变为庆长十二年，年轻公卿和女官之间闹出诸多丑闻。

units.source_en: Desire between men and women is natural, but once natural feeling becomes licentiousness, society can no longer tolerate it.
units.source_zh: 男女之欲乃人之常情，然而常情一旦变成放纵，就非世人所能容忍了。

units.source_en: The disorder in the inner court enraged Emperor Go-Yōzei, who immediately ordered Ieyasu to deal with it.
units.source_zh: 内廷风纪混乱让后阳成天皇大怒，即着家康处理。

paragraphs.source_zh: 如此种种，最终演变为庆长十二年，年轻公卿和女官之间闹出诸多丑闻。男女之欲乃人之常情，然而常情一旦变成放纵，就非世人所能容忍了。内廷风纪混乱让后阳成天皇大怒，即着家康处理。

paragraphs.source_en: Through this affair, the emperor opened the door for the shogunate to intervene in palace affairs. The question of discipline naturally caused an uproar at the imperial court. Early in the fifteenth year of Keichō, Emperor Go-Yōzei proposed abdicating. Although Ieyasu's petition secured a postponement, the course of events could no longer be reversed.

units.source_en: Through this affair, the emperor opened the door for the shogunate to intervene in palace affairs.
units.source_zh: 天皇通过此事，向幕府打开了干涉禁宫的大门。

units.source_en: The question of discipline naturally caused an uproar at the imperial court.
units.source_zh: 风纪问题自然在皇廷引起风波。

units.source_en: Early in the fifteenth year of Keichō, Emperor Go-Yōzei proposed abdicating.
units.source_zh: 庆长十五年初，后阳成天皇提出禅位。

units.source_en: Although Ieyasu's petition secured a postponement, the course of events could no longer be reversed.
units.source_zh: 在家康奏请下虽得以延期，然而事情已无可挽回。

paragraphs.source_zh: 天皇通过此事，向幕府打开了干涉禁宫的大门。风纪问题自然在皇廷引起风波。庆长十五年初，后阳成天皇提出禅位。在家康奏请下虽得以延期，然而事情已无可挽回。

paragraphs.source_en: By the end of the fifteenth year of Keichō, when Nagoya Castle was largely complete, the emperor's abdication had become a certainty. The formal transfer of the throne to Prince Kotohito took place on the twenty-seventh day of the third month of the following year; thus Ieyasu's plan to go to the capital in the fifteenth year of Keichō was finally realized in the spring of the sixteenth.

units.source_en: By the end of the fifteenth year of Keichō, when Nagoya Castle was largely complete, the emperor's abdication had become a certainty.
units.source_zh: 名古屋城基本完工的庆长十五年岁末，天皇退位成为定局。

units.source_en: The formal transfer of the throne to Prince Kotohito took place on the twenty-seventh day of the third month of the following year; thus Ieyasu's plan to go to the capital in the fifteenth year of Keichō was finally realized in the spring of the sixteenth.
units.source_zh: 正式传位于政仁亲王，是为转年三月二十七，故家康庆长十五年计划上洛一事，终于在同十六年春得以成行。

paragraphs.source_zh: 名古屋城基本完工的庆长十五年岁末，天皇退位成为定局。正式传位于政仁亲王，是为转年三月二十七，故家康庆长十五年计划上洛一事，终于在同十六年春得以成行。

paragraphs.source_en: “Namu Amida Butsu, Namu Amida Butsu...” Even at the venerable age of seventy, Ieyasu was still praying for the souls of the dead.

units.source_en: “Namu Amida Butsu, Namu Amida Butsu...” Even at the venerable age of seventy, Ieyasu was still praying for the souls of the dead.
units.source_zh: “南无阿弥陀佛，南无阿弥陀佛……”七十高寿的家康，还在为亡灵祷告。

paragraphs.source_zh: “南无阿弥陀佛，南无阿弥陀佛……”七十高寿的家康，还在为亡灵祷告。

paragraphs.source_en: Ieyasu set aside his daily devotions and left Sunpu for his final journey to the capital on the sixth day of the third month in the sixteenth year of Keichō.

units.source_en: Ieyasu set aside his daily devotions and left Sunpu for his final journey to the capital on the sixth day of the third month in the sixteenth year of Keichō.
units.source_zh: 家康放下日课，离开骏府，最后一次上洛，是为庆长十六年三月初六。

paragraphs.source_en: On the way, Ieyasu inspected the completed Nagoya Castle and felt immeasurably gratified. On the seventeenth, Ieyasu and his party reached Kyoto. Kiyomasa worried that many Tokugawa retainers had died at Fushimi during the Battle of Sekigahara; if their survivors still harbored resentment, they might rashly seize the opportunity to rise and do Hideyori harm. paragraphs.source_en: Toyotomi Hideyori's arrival in Kyoto was fixed for the twenty-eighth day of the third month. The decision departed from custom and was exceedingly unusual for Ieyasu.
